entries.rationale: The shipped Rust controller does not invoke Perl or compile attacker-controlled Perl regular expressions. The vulnerable trie construction therefore has no reachable application input path.

No HTTP, WebSocket, controller startup, health-check, or command path extracts attacker-provided archives through Perl Archive::Tar. The vulnerable symlink extraction function is not reachable from service inputs.
The vulnerability is limited to 32-bit Perl builds. Release jobs build and inspect linux/amd64 images, so the affected integer-width condition is not present in the shipped controller artifact.

The controller, VNC adapter, startup scripts, and deterministic desktop application expose no XML input or libxml2 parsing operation. The crafted XML document required for the denial of service is not accepted by any service endpoint.
